name: Search Technical Topic
query: Find where I wrote about MCP OAuth, Cloud Run, and deployment
context: The authenticated user has an project named 'AI Infrastructure'. The exact project_id is not provided. The project contains notebook content covering MCP servers, OAuth authentication, Cloud Run deployment, and related infrastructure. The user wants to locate the relevant notes.
expected_behavior: Identifies that the user wants project knowledge discovery
Uses get_projects to identify the AI Infrastructure project when project_id is unknown
Uses the actual project_id returned by project discovery
Constructs a query preserving important technical terms such as 'MCP', 'OAuth', 'Cloud Run', and 'deployment'
Does not reduce the query to a generic term such as 'deployment' when the specific terms are available
Does not invent the content of the notebooks
Does not modify any project or notebook data
success_criteria: search_project receives a query containing the important technical concepts
The returned results are presented clearly
The model does not fabricate technical details that were not returned
The response remains within the current search-project MCP contract
